scope: Direct Laminar project query; rows since 2026-09-07 UTC, metadata model gpt-5.5/gpt-5.6-luna, exact cohort size 106/60; deduplicated by datapoint id. Screening inventory only; denominator size alone does not establish task identity or judgment coverage.
query: SELECT toString(evaluation_id) evaluation_id, any(JSONExtractString(metadata,'message')) message, any(JSONExtractString(metadata,'model')) model, any(JSONExtractString(metadata,'harness')) harness, count() assigned, avg(JSONExtractFloat(scores,'findings')) findings_mean, avg(JSONExtractFloat(scores,'laith')) laith_mean FROM (SELECT id,evaluation_id,metadata,scores FROM evaluation_datapoints WHERE created_at >= '2026-09-07' AND JSONExtractString(metadata,'model') IN ('gpt-5.5','gpt-5.6-luna') ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1 BY id) GROUP BY evaluation_id HAVING assigned IN (60,106) ORDER BY findings_mean DESC,laith_mean DESC
